title: Lulu the Little Duck | Short Story for Toddlers
description:
Meet Lulu the little duck! Lulu says hello to a jumping frog, a hopping bunny and a buzzing bee, and then they all play together under a rainbow.

A gentle short story for toddlers and preschoolers, with simple words to read along:
Jump, jump, jump! Hop, hop, hop! Buzz, buzz, buzz!

Good night, Lulu.
